body.name: \mathfrak H_{\mathrm{lb}}
body.construction:
Choose \(L=1-\eta_+\), a fixed \(s_0\) with \(0<s_0<\min\{L,\lambda_0\}/4\), and
\[
0<A\le \frac{c_+-2^\kappa c_-}{2^{\kappa+1}}.
\]
For each finite cell count \(N\), put \(t_j=s_0 2^{-j}\) and
\(w_j=A(1-2^{-\kappa})t_j^\kappa\), and assign mass \(w_j/N\) to distinct active points \(x_{j,k}\), \(j\ge0\), \(1\le k\le N\), with baseline propensity \(e_0(x_{j,k})=t_j\). Use disjoint points for an untouched dyadic background and for the unperturbed remaining mass. On this common support build four subexperiments: shell-localized treated Gaussian mean shifts for \(Q_\kappa\); an untreated-observation coupling at scale \(n^{-1/(\kappa+1)}\); a signed-cell treated fuzzy mixture on \(B_s=\{s<e_0\le2s\}\) at scale \(s\asymp r_{en}^{2/(\kappa+2)}\); and a signed-cell control fuzzy mixture on the fixed band \(B=\{s_c<e_0\le2s_c\}=\{x_{j_c,k}:1\le k\le N\}\), where \(j_c\ge1\), \(s_c=t_{j_c+1}\), and \(P_X(B)=w_{j_c}\). In the treated fuzzy family use \(g_1=hZ_k\), \(e_{\theta,Z}=e_0/(1+\theta\delta Z_k)\), and public \(m_1=0\), \(p=e_0\). In the control fuzzy family use \(g_0=h_0Z_k\), \(h_0=c_A r_{0n}/\sqrt{P_X(B)}\), public \(m_0=0\), \(p=e_0\), and
\[
1-e_{\theta,Z}=\frac{1-e_0}{1+\theta tZ_k},
\qquad
t=c_A\min\left\{\frac{r_{en}}{\sqrt{P_X(B)}},\frac14\right\}.
\]
Keep the public functions fixed inside each subexperiment, take the cell count large enough to make collisions and prior-target fluctuations negligible, and combine the four component separations by the maximum-to-sum comparison.
